newsitem.title: LATVIA: HANSBANK-LATVIJA MAKES Q1 PROFIT VS PLANNED LOSS.
newsitem.headline: HANSBANK-LATVIJA MAKES Q1 PROFIT VS PLANNED LOSS.

text.p: Hansabank-Latvija, part of Estonia's Hansapank , said on Monday its first quarter profit was 300,000 lats versus a planned loss of 240,000 lats.

The bank said in a statement that the larger than planned profit was due to higher income from its dealing department, which were 230,000 lats higher than planned, and lower than expected administrative costs.
The bank said that the administrative costs were 385,000 lats lower than budgeted.
"The total income from financial activity before administrative expenses in the first quarter were eight percent higher than planned," the bank said.
The bank had assets at the end of the first quarter of 55.59 million lats.
It said that compared to December, the share of securities in its balance sheet rose by 19 percent to 2.4 million lats and was 27 percent of assets.
The size of its loan portfolio rose 26 percent or three million lats, new short-term credits were 498,000 lats and long-term credits were 1.6 million lats.
The bank also said it had term deposits of 6.79 million lats at the end of the first quarter.
